content: Play Store scrape 2026-09-24: BG radio market dominated by generic country-template apps. Радио Онлайн България (net.radioexpert, Serbian dev) 500K+/33.4K reviews/4.7; Radio Bulgaria FM online (com.radiolight.bulgarie) 100K+/21.1K/4.9; Radio Bulgaria radio online (radio.bulgaria.play.online.free) 100K+/11.6K/4.9; BG Radio (com.crystalmissions.bgradio) 50K+/720/5.0; official BNR app (bg.bnr.app) only 1K+/27 reviews/4.1. All contain ads. Common features: favourites, search, sleep timer, alarm, Android Auto, Chromecast, widget, share, city/genre, recents. Complaints: intrusive popup ads covering UI/nav, ads interrupting stream, playback stopping after 1-5 min, no now-playing, no lock-screen controls, cannot reorder favourites, no dark mode, no low-bitrate option, steering-wheel next/prev not reflected in UI, paid IAP not unlocking Android Auto; BNR app: bad UX, ineffective search, no favourites.
